shared_elements: low relief carving of figures on a flat panel
seated/standing figures facing a focal point
horizontal registers or bands (implied in A by ground line, explicit in B)
justification: Both show human figures in profile in shallow relief, but that is a near-universal convention; A depicts a dynamic narrative hunt with a chariot, horses, archer and collapsing lions filling a single wide field, while B shows static seated and standing figures in stacked registers surrounded by dense columns of script signs on a round-topped tablet. The subject matter, composition and figural attitudes have essentially nothing specific in common.
